# Documents

This folder contains the raw text chunks extracted from the 2023, 2024, and 2025 annual reports of the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Diseases (DANIBD). The documents are sequentially divided into parts that preserve the original PDF pagination, covering everything from executive summaries and steering group recommendations to detailed quality indicator results, surgical re-operation audits, and regional hospital comments. These pages serve as the foundational source material for the wiki's entities, topics, and comparisons, with every factual claim in the database traceable back to these specific extracts.

## Pages

- [[danibd-2023-part-001]] — Conclusions, recommendations, and demographic characteristics for pediatric and adult IBD patients from the 2023 report.
- [[danibd-2023-part-002]] — Adult patient demographics and the national overview of quality indicator results for the 2022-2023 period.
- [[danibd-2023-part-003]] — Detailed results and data rules for biological medicine monitoring (BMSL) and 30-day surgical re-operation rates.
- [[danibd-2023-part-004]] — PSC colonoscopy follow-up results, clinical disease descriptions, data foundation, and database coverage validation.
- [[danibd-2023-part-005]] — Steering group membership and appendix tables detailing regional patient demographics and education codes.
- [[danibd-2023-part-006]] — Appendix tables cataloging specific surgical and re-operation procedure codes, PSC demographics, and regional comments.
- [[danibd-2024-part-001]] — Conclusions, recommendations, and pediatric patient characteristics from the 2024 annual report.
- [[danibd-2024-part-002]] — Adult patient demographics, contact frequencies, and the national overview of all seven quality indicators.
- [[danibd-2024-part-003]] — Results and clinical discussions for adult and pediatric diagnostic workup indicators (colonoscopy, MRI, gastroscopy).
- [[danibd-2024-part-004]] — Performance data for newly diagnosed patient education and post-operative Crohn's disease endoscopic follow-up.
- [[danibd-2024-part-005]] — Indicator results for DEXA scanning during steroid treatments and fecal calprotectin monitoring for BMSL patients.
- [[danibd-2024-part-006]] — Continued BMSL monitoring data, 30-day re-operation rates, and surgical procedure coding rules.
- [[danibd-2024-part-007]] — Re-operation discussions, PSC surveillance colonoscopy results, disease background, and registry data foundations.
- [[danibd-2024-part-008]] — Database coverage estimates, steering group members, and appendix tables for regional demographics and education rates.
- [[danibd-2024-part-009]] — Appendix tables breaking down BMSL drug types, surgical interventions, and re-operation procedures.
- [[danibd-2024-part-010]] — Regional comments and audit responses from hospitals across the five Danish regions regarding 2024 indicator performance.
- [[danibd-2025-part-001]] — Conclusions, recommendations, and historical patient inclusion trends spanning the database's first three years.
- [[danibd-2025-part-002]] — Pediatric and adult patient characteristics, highlighting the high frequency of hospital contacts and resource utilization.
- [[danibd-2025-part-003]] — National indicator overview and detailed adult diagnostic workup results across regions and departments.
- [[danibd-2025-part-004]] — Pediatric workup results, including a steering group decision to modify the indicator definition, and patient education metrics.
- [[danibd-2025-part-005]] — Discussions on education implementation and performance data for post-operative Crohn's disease colonoscopy follow-up.
- [[danibd-2025-part-006]] — Indicator results for DEXA scanning compliance and fecal calprotectin monitoring in biologically treated patients.
- [[danibd-2025-part-007]] — BMSL data rules, 30-day surgical re-operation trends, and department-level performance variations.
- [[danibd-2025-part-008]] — PSC surveillance outcomes, clinical disease context, and the registry's data foundation and inclusion criteria.
- [[danibd-2025-part-009]] — Coverage validation, steering group roster, and appendix tables for regional patient demographics.
- [[danibd-2025-part-010]] — Appendix tables detailing specific BMSL drug administrations, surgical procedures, and re-operation codes.
- [[danibd-2025-part-011]] — PSC patient demographics and qualitative regional comments addressing data discrepancies and local audit findings.
